procitem.title: Procedure to be developed in the Operator's MEL

inform.para: Alternate procedure must be established and used to secure the cockpit and to access to the cockpit in accordance with the Operator’s security policy.
This alternate procedure may consider the use of any acceptable means approved by the National Aviation Authority.
Since the CDLS Normal system is deactivated, the keypad becomes inoperative.
The flight crew must brief the cabin crew that the CDLS keypad is inoperative.
For a request access to the cockpit, use the cabin interphone.
At least two crewmembers must be present in the cockpit at all times during the flight.
